reserve.basis: ceil(20% × 296.82) = 60 h; remainder of original 90 h pool = 30 h for deferred work. Reservations are idle capacity until an identified risk is assigned, not extra Estimate or completed work.
reserve.role_limits: Only 35 of scheduled 60 hours belong to programmers; capacity cannot be freely exchanged between roles or assumed to repair any critical delay.
